description: Fixed evaluation corpus for the EV battery NLG diagnostic reporter. All scenarios are SYNTHETIC and authored for this academic project; they are NOT real vehicle observations and the reference reports are illustrative, not manufacturer-approved diagnostics.

scenarios.label: typical safe pack
scenarios.reference_report: The predicted battery health is 90%, classified as Safe. All readings are within the configured normal band, so routine monitoring is appropriate. No parameter crossed its review threshold.

scenarios.label: low state of charge
scenarios.reference_report: The state of charge is 15%, at or below the configured low threshold. The predicted health is 82% (Safe). Recharge before the next trip if range is insufficient.

scenarios.label: elevated temperature warning
scenarios.reference_report: The temperature is 41 C, above the configured high threshold, and the predicted health is 68% (Warning). Check the cooling path and compare against the pack's rated range.

scenarios.label: high discharge current
scenarios.reference_report: The absolute current is 62 A (discharge), above the configured high threshold. Moderate the discharge rate and review the load profile.

scenarios.label: elevated degradation index

recommendations: Inspect degraded cells and verify pack balancing

scenarios.reference_report: The degradation index is 38, at or above the configured service-review level. The predicted health is 61% (Warning). Schedule a technician inspection of cell balancing.

scenarios.label: multiple critical concerns
scenarios.reference_report: The predicted health is 30% (Critical). Temperature is 48 C (critical), state of charge is 9% (very low), current is 58 A, and the degradation index is 42. Multiple parameters need prompt review.

scenarios.label: model fallback in use
scenarios.reference_report: The predicted health is 76% (Safe), produced by the fallback heuristic because the trained model was unavailable. Treat the score as indicative only.

scenarios.label: temperature exactly at review threshold
scenarios.reference_report: The temperature is 35 C, at the configured review threshold. The predicted health is 83% (Safe). Monitor the temperature trend.

scenarios.label: declining health trend
scenarios.reference_report: The predicted health is 70% (Warning) and has fallen roughly 18 points over the last three records. Monitor the trend closely.

scenarios.label: safe status but critical temperature (conflict)
scenarios.reference_report: The overall status is Safe, yet the temperature of 50 C is in the critical band. These conflicting signals should be reviewed rather than assuming the pack is problem-free.
